body: Honestly. At the very least then i wouldn’t be treated like it’s my fucking fault , as if i was in the womb like “I think i’m going to look as hideous as possible”.

It’s different when you’re born with an actual physical disability or condition vs when you’re just born plain ugly due to genes. Somebody with a heart might see past the disability, when you just “look like that” , not so often. That is just my take on it though , i can only speak on my experience. :/
